items.title: Target's Stock Is on a Tear in 2026. Can It Still Go Higher?
items.summary: The retail stock recently hit a new 52-week high as it has been outperforming the S&P 500 this year by a wide margin.

items.title: Costco's E-commerce Momentum Keeps Its Growth Engine Running
items.summary: Costco's digital sales surge 17.9% in August and 20.9% in fiscal 2026, highlighting e-commerce as a growing pillar of its retail footprint.

items.title: Attack of the Clones Speeds Up CVS Strategy
items.summary: “No, I don’t think so,” answered Joon Sung Park, co-founder and CEO at “digital twin” startup Simile, on the opening day of the Leadership Institute’s WSJ Technology Council Summit yesterday.  Twins created with Simile are currently helping  CVS Health  make decisions more quickly and confidently, executives said as part of the same discussion.  When the pharmacy and insurance company wanted to encourage adoption of lower-cost biologic drug alternatives, twins of the consumer pool suggested that people wanted to hear recommendations from their healthcare providers, said  Tilak Mandadi,  executive vice president of ventures and chief experience and technology officer at CVS Health.

items.title: How a Costco partner's bankruptcy could benefit its biggest rival
items.summary: Reckitt does not need to win a vendor slot or navigate Costco’s notoriously demanding supplier requirements. It is already approved, integrated, and selling.

items.title: Target Names New CMO
items.summary: Continuing to build its comeback strategy, the retailer hires Mark Weinstein, Hilton's CMO, to fill the vacant role.

items.title: Kroger Q2 Earnings Beat on Cost Savings, Sales Outlook Cut
items.summary: Kroger beats Q2 earnings estimates as cost savings, pharmacy, fuel and e-commerce gains offset soft sales, while fiscal 2026 sales guidance is cut.

items.title: Can Macy's Raised 2026 Outlook Offset Third-Quarter Earnings Risk?
items.summary: M raises its 2026 outlook after stronger Q2 results, but heavier Q3 investment and soft earnings guidance keep near-term risks in focus.

items.title: Is Macy's Stock Cheap Enough to Buy Despite Uneven Second-Half Growth?
items.summary: M trades below industry and market valuations as stronger Q2 execution and raised guidance support the stock, despite soft second-half expectations.
